summary: SettingsManager holds a dictionary of settings instances keyed by structural SettingsParameters. Cold construction currently retains runtime inputs; get_settings_object returns the cached instance or a shallow overlay. MAS-SEC-001 protects supported reconstruction recipes, but cold contamination and shared nested live state remain MAS-SEC-002 work.
lifecycle_notes: settings_object_cache is a plain dict — not thread-safe for concurrent write (first creation of new settings class)
Falls back to plain BaseSettings construction for non-MountainAshBaseSettings classes
get_settings_object() raises ValueError if cache entry is not a MountainAshBaseSettings — indicates cache corruption
risks: Non-thread-safe dict cache — concurrent first-access could create multiple instances
